assessment.diversity_evidence: All sampled stories use the same torn-kite problem, tape repair, relaunch, and kite-dancing ending. Differences such as names, parent labels, whether the kite falls on the grass, and wording of the repair do not create distinct plots (for example, s000014, s000028, s000053, and s000041). This assessment describes only this sample, not the generator as a whole.

plot_groups.summary: A child finds a kite torn, gets or uses tape to repair it, then launches it and sees it fly successfully.
